'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Mark Walseth DS There Is No Try''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walseth]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Starting line messy (There Is No / Enforcement); Death Star Conference Room package treated as There Is No Try. Shields list includes ships as written.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Walseth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is No Try / Do Or Do Not|There Is No Try]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
